roles.name: Print operator
roles.description: Collects finished prints, clears up failed ones, and sets the same job going again on any printer you have told to keep printing.

roles.name: Packer
roles.description: Packs each order as soon as the print for it is on the shelf, and crates up contract work for the courier.

roles.name: Finisher
roles.description: Goes over every print on the shelf with the blowtorch, so what you sell has a better finish.
